heading: Questions people ask before they buy

items.question: What does 916 hallmark mean?
items.answer: 916 is the fineness of 22-karat gold: 916 parts per thousand, or 91.6% pure. Every piece sold in the UAE must carry a hallmark under Federal Law No. 11 of 2015, and Dubai Municipality’s Dubai Central Laboratory inspects jewellers to check it. The stamp is applied after assay, so purity is verified rather than promised.

items.question: How do I know a diamond is genuine?
items.answer: Every diamond is instrument-tested at the counter before it is sold, and larger stones come with an independent laboratory grading report. Ask to watch the test.

items.question: What does lifetime maintenance cover?
items.answer: Cleaning, polishing and a check of the settings, for as long as you own the piece. Repairs, resizing and replacing a lost stone are separate work, quoted before we start; ask in store for the full terms.

items.question: How does the 0% deduction gold exchange work?
items.answer: Bring your old gold. We test its purity in front of you and credit its gold value by weight, at the day’s rate and with no weight deduction, against a new piece. Making charges and VAT apply to the new piece. Ask whether the terms cover gold bought elsewhere, and how a cash sale differs, before you come.

items.question: What is the return policy?
items.answer: Unworn pieces in their original condition can be returned within 14 days of purchase with the invoice, and the certificate where one was issued. Customised, engraved and resized pieces are exchange-only. Returns are taken at the branch that sold the piece. This is our own commitment. It does not limit your rights for defective goods under UAE Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection.
